title: Noise Gate
text: Dynamic range gate, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Threshold (dB)} sets the operation threshold, {View static characteristic} sets the open static characteristic plot of dynamic range gate, {Attack time (s)} sets the time for applied gain to ramp up, {Release time (s)} sets the time for applied gain to ramp down, {Hold time (s)} sets the time during which applied gain holds, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the input sample rate, {Output gain (dB)} sets the gain applied on each input sample, {Sidechain} enables sidechain input and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Gain applied to each input sample matrix

params.name: Threshold (dB)
params.values: Operation threshold –10 (default) | scalar in the range –140 to 0 inclusive

params.name: View static characteristic
params.values: Open static characteristic plot of dynamic range gate button

params.name: Attack time (s)
params.values: Time for applied gain to ramp up 0.05 (default) | scalar in the range 0 to 4 inclusive

params.name: Release time (s)
params.values: Time for applied gain to ramp down 0.2 (default) | scalar in the range 0 to 4 inclusive

params.name: Hold time (s)
params.values: Time during which applied gain holds steady 0.05 (default) | scalar in the range 0 to 4

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate on (default) | off

params.name: Output gain (dB)
params.values: Gain applied on each input sample off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
